title: Valgard Small, yearly (EUR)
description: Valgard Small is a yearly package from Scalytics for Valgard, a proactive cyber defense add-on: your own cyber defense team. Find it, block it, prove it. It covers up to 250 assets in scope, with the full product and all features. An asset is an IP, host, domain or network device. It runs on hardware you own, as an add-on to Lascaris Streamhouse or the Kafka you already run: Confluent, Apache Kafka, Redpanda or Amazon MSK. It finds known exploited flaws, using the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (KEV) and FIRST's Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS), on your own assets inside a scope you sign. Time-boxed blocks on F5, Palo Alto and OPNsense lift themselves on a timer. Bigger changes wait for your approval. A rescan and signed records are evidence for NIS2 and DORA. The price covers software, detection content, and CVE and KEV feed updates. The customer provides the hardware. Valgard is in alpha, in internal testing. Design partners can register interest at https://www.scalytics.io/contact. Scopes above 2,000 assets are quoted separately.
